wishLines: May your iced coffees always be sweet and your skin perpetually glowing.
May you never have to parallel park in front of an outdoor café audience.
May our spontaneous trip ideas always become booked flight confirmations.
May you continue to out-dress every person in every room you enter.
May we stay completely, unapologetically unhinged for the next 70 years.

paragraphs: Life with you is pure unfiltered cinematic chaos — and I wouldn't trade a single second for the quietest sanity on earth.
Thank you for being the person who answers FaceTime calls while brushing teeth, who shares fries without an eye-roll, and who celebrates every tiny win like an Olympic gold medal.
You make every single room warmer just by existing in it. Here is to another year of being completely, unapologetically unhinged together.
